title: Rune-Jit Smithing Data
description: JSON Schema for data/skills/smithing.yaml. Validate with: python3 -c "import jsonschema, yaml, json; jsonschema.validate(yaml.safe_load(open('data/skills/smithing.yaml')), json.load(open('data/schemas/smithing-data.schema.json')))"

meta.description: Skill-level metadata consumed by the plugin at startup.

ticks_per_attempt.description: Game ticks per smelt/smith action (1 tick = 0.6s)

hammer_item_id.description: Item ID of the hammer required to smith at an anvil

furnace_object_ids.description: Object IDs of furnaces (populated from cache extraction)

anvil_object_ids.description: Object IDs of anvils (populated from cache extraction)

bars.description: All smeltable bars keyed by constant name (e.g. BRONZE, RUNE).

level_required.description: Smithing level required to smelt this bar

smelt_xp.description: Smithing XP awarded per bar smelted (exact wiki value)

bar_item_id.description: Item ID of the resulting bar

ingredients.description: Ores consumed to smelt this bar.

ore_item_id.description: Item ID of the ore consumed

qty.description: Quantity of this ore consumed per bar

wiki.description: OSRS wiki URL for this bar (required citation)

smithing.description: All smithable anvil items keyed by constant name (e.g. RUNE_SCIMITAR).

level_required.description: Smithing level required to smith this item

smith_xp.description: Smithing XP awarded per item smithed (exact wiki value)

bar_type.description: Key into the bars map identifying the bar consumed

bars_required.description: Number of bars consumed to smith this item

output_qty.description: Quantity of the output item produced (e.g. 15 for cannonballs)

wiki.description: OSRS wiki URL for this item (required citation)
